z-m-18-01.title: Ukuba kukho ulingano olu-2, isisombululo sihlala sisibini esi-1?
z-m-18-01.topic: Iinkqubo zokulingana komgca ezingenasisombululo okanye ezinezisombululo ezingapheliyo
z-m-18-01.goal: Qinisekisa ngokuhlola isisombululo, ugwebo lolwazi, nemizekelo oyenzayo ukuba xa ukulingana komgca okuli-2 okunobungaziwa obuli-2 kudityaniswa, isisombululo siwela kwiimeko ezintathu (isibini esi-1, akukho, ezingapheliyo), uze uchaze phantsi kwaluphi umqathango eyiphi imeko yenzeka.
z-m-18-01.material:
USoyoung wathi, "Ukuba kukho ukulingana komgca okuli-2 okunobungaziwa obuli-2 x no-y, kuhlala kukho isibini esi-1 kanye (x, y) esanelisa omabini ulingano ngaxeshanye." Apha x no-y banokuba ngamanani nawaphi na, yaye ulingano lonke lungulingano lomgca olunemigangatho yamanani aphelele. USoyoung ufuna ukuhlola ingcinga yakhe ngenkqubo yokulingana engezantsi. Indlela yokufunda: 'x kudibanisa 2y kulingana no-6', '2x kudibanisa 4y kulingana no-10'.
  ㉠ x + 2y = 6
  ㉡ 2x + 4y = 10
z-m-18-01.thinking.0: Ukufumana nokulungisa umgca kwisisombululo apho isigqibo siphuma ngaphandle kweziseko
z-m-18-01.thinking.1: Ukugweba ukuba kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi luni ukugqiba inani lezisombululo
z-m-18-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza wena iinkcazelo ezininzi ezanelisa iimeko nokuzihlola
z-m-18-01.thinking.3: Ukuhlela iimeko apho ibango le-'ihlala' libamba khona
z-m-18-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuba isisombululo senkcazelo elayinini enezingaziwayo ezimbini sisibini (x, y)
z-m-18-01.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yesisombululo senkqubo yeenkcazelo (isibini esanelisa zombini iinkcazelo ngaxeshanye)
z-m-18-01.prereq.2: Amava okubona inkcazelo elayinini ax+by=c njengomgca kwiplani yokulungelelanisa (inqanaba leBanga 8; akufuneki wazi ubudlelwane nenani lezisombululo)
z-m-18-01.s.s1.prompt: Kwisisombululo esingezantsi, awasibhalela uSoyoung ㉠ no-㉡, khetha umgca omnye apho iziseko zesigqibo zilahlekileyo. Beka ecaleni ingcinga yokuqala (ingxelo kaSoyoung) okwangoku uhlole umgca ngomgca ukuba iinkcazelo ziyabamba ngokwenene.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka (0, 0) kwicala lasekhohlo lenkcazelo ㉠, x + 2y = 6, uhlole ukuba iba yi-6.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba kumgca 2 i-2x + 4y efanayo inokulingana namanani omabini 12 no-10 ngaxeshanye.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuphindaphinda amacala omabini ka-㉠ x + 2y = 6 ngo-2 kunika 2x + 4y = 12.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukuthelekisa le nkcazelo no-㉡ 2x + 4y = 10, amacala asekhohlo ayafana kodwa amacala asekunene ayahluka, 12 no-10.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngoko x no-y zombini ziyanyamalala, ngoko x = 0, y = 0 sisisombululo.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko isisombululo sale nkqubo yeenkcazelo sisibini esinye (0, 0).
z-m-18-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca 3 awulandeli. Kumgca 2 kwaphuma ukuba i-2x + 4y efanayo kufuneka ibe zombini 12 no-10, oko kuthetha ukuba ayinakwanelisa naliphi na ixabiso le-x ne-y. 'x no-y zinyamalele' akuthethi 'x no-y zi-0.' Ukuba ufaka (0, 0) kwi-㉠, ufumana 0 = 6, ongabambi. Umgca 4 sisigqibo esithwala impazamo yomgca 3.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.prompt: Shiya ㉠ njengoko injalo utshintshe ㉡ ibe 2x + 4y = c. (c inokuba linani nelinye, kwaye asikayazi ixabiso layo. Indlela yokufunda: '2x kunye no-4y lilingana ne-c') Ngoko ngoko sikwaziyo kuphela, ungathini malunga nesisombululo sale nkqubo yeenkcazelo?
z-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala inkcazelo oyifumana ngokuphindaphinda amacala omabini ka-㉠ ngo-2 uyithelekise ecaleni kwefom ka-㉡.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka i-12 nenani elingeyo-12 kwi-c, enye nenye, uvavanye ukuba iinkcazelo ezimbini ziba yimeko efanayo.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.a: Nokuba c yintoni, isisombululo sihlala sigqitywa sisibini esinye
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.a: Olu lukhetho olukhokelele ukholo lokuqala lokuba iinkcazelo ezimbini zithetha isibini esinye. Awuhlolanga ukuba icala lasekhohlo 2x + 4y lingamaxesha ama-2 elika-㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.b: Nokuba c yintoni, akukho x, y zanelisa zombini iinkcazelo
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.b: Ubhengeze 'azisoze zidibane' ujonge kuphela icala lasekhohlo lika-㉡. Awuqwalaselanga ukuba ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso le-c, iinkcazelo ezimbini zinokuba yinkcazelo enye na.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.c: Kufuneka sazi ixabiso le-c. Ngokuxhomekeke ku-c, akukho sisombululo okanye zininzi ngokungenasiphelo
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.d: Ukuba c yi-12 akukho sisombululo, kwaye nakweyiphi enye c zininzi ngokungenasiphelo
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.d: Ufumene iimeko ezimbini kodwa ukudibaniswa kujikisiwe. Bhala wena ukuba ㉡ iba yinkcazelo efanayo no-㉠ xa i-2x + 4y yi-12, amaxesha ama-2 e-6.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.explain: Icala lasekhohlo lika-㉡, 2x + 4y, lingamaxesha ama-2 elicala lasekhohlo lika-㉠. Ukuba c = 12, ㉡ yi-㉠ enamacala omabini aphindaphindwe, ngoko yimeko efanayo kwaye zikho izisombululo ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo, kwaye ukuba c ayiyi-12, i-2x + 4y efanayo kuya kufuneka ibe lixabiso elahlukileyo kwi-12, amaxesha ama-2 e-6, ngoko akukho sisombululo. Kule nkqubo yeenkcazelo, akukho xabiso le-c apho isisombululo sisibini esinye ncam. Ngoko ukuthetha ngenani lezisombululo, kufuneka ixabiso le-c.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku yila inkqubo yeenkcazelo ene-㉠ x + 2y = 6 engenasisombululo kwaphela. Bhala inkcazelo entsha njenge-ax + by = c, wenze iinkcazelo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo. (a, b, c ngamanani apheleleyo, a no-b azili-0 kwaye nganye inexabiso eliphelele le-20 ubuninzi, kwaye c inexabiso eliphelele le-100 ubuninzi. 'ax + by = c' ifundwa 'a x kunye no-b y lilingana ne-c'.)
z-m-18-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula okwenzekayo kwi-s2 xa c yayingeyi-12, uthelekise ubudlelwane imilinganiselo ye-x ne-y eyayinabo no-㉠ ngoko.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.hint.1: Gqiba a no-b kuqala, emva koko tshintsha c uvavanye omnye ngomnye ukuba likho na (x, y) elanelisa zombini loo nkcazelo no-㉠. Kufuneka ushiye c eyenza inkcazelo efanayo no-㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c1: a, b, c kufuneka zibe ngamanani apheleleyo.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c2: a no-b akufuneki zibe ngu-0 kwaye zinexabiso eliphelele le-20 ubuninzi, kwaye c kufuneka ibe nexabiso eliphelele le-100 ubuninzi.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c3: Imilinganiselo ye-x ne-y inomlinganiselo ofanayo no-㉠ (umlinganiselo we-y ungamaxesha ama-2 omlinganiselo we-x).
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Jonga ukuba ikho ubudlelwane obufanayo phakathi kwemilinganiselo ye-x ne-y njengakwi-㉠. Ngale fom, imigca idibana kwinqaku elinye.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c4: Ixabiso elingatshintshiyo ekunene alinamaxesha afanayo njengakwi-㉠ (ayiyiyo inkcazelo efanayo).
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c4: Le nkcazelo iba yinkcazelo efanayo no-㉠, ngoko zikho izisombululo ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo. Ukuze kungabikho sisombululo, ixabiso elingatshintshiyo ekunene kufuneka lahluke.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.explain: Nge-(a, b, c) = (1, 2, 5), x + 2y kuya kufuneka ibe zombini 6 no-5, ngoko akukho sisombululo. (2, 4, 7) kunye ne-(-3, -6, -4) ziyafana. (2, 4, 12) lamaxesha ama-2 elika-㉠, ngoko yinkcazelo efanayo, kwaye (1, 3, 4) inobudlelwane obahlukileyo phakathi kwemilinganiselo ye-x ne-y, ngoko imigca idibana kwinqaku elinye. Iinkcazelo ezimele umgca ofanayo, njenge-(2, 4, 7) kunye ne-(4, 8, 14), zibalwa njenge-nye.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.prompt: Phendula uSoyoung ngale ndlela. Ingxelo ethi 'Ukuba kukho iinkcazelo ezimbini, isisombululo sihlala sisibini esinye' ichanekile nini kwaye iphosakele nini? Bhala iimeko apho isisombululo sisibini esinye, akukho, okanye zininzi ngokungenasiphelo, uzidibanise nefom yeenkcazelo (imilinganiselo nexabiso elingatshintshiyo ekunene).
z-m-18-01.s.s4.hint.0: Yenza izibini zeenkcazelo owazenzileyo kwi-s2 nakwi-s3 no-㉠ omnye ngomnye, uthelekise ukuba imilinganiselo nexabiso elingatshintshiyo ekunene lingamaxesha amangaphi ka-㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.hint.1: Zahlule ube zizibini ezingenasisombululo, izibini ezinezisombululo ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo, nezibini ezinesibini esinye, ubhale phantsi oko kwahluke ngenye nenye.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.placeholder: umz., Ukuba imilinganiselo ye-x ne-y kwiinkcazelo ezimbini yi ..., ngoko ...
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ngokwahlukileyo ukuba imeko engenasisombululo neyezisombululo ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo nganye ivela kwifom yeenkcazelo enjani?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale nokuba nini kuphuma isibini esinye kuphela?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unike imizekelo yamanani njengobungqina, njengenkcazelo oyenzileyo kwi-s3 okanye ㉠, ㉡?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.model.0: Ingxelo kaSoyoung ayihlali ichanekile. Ukuba umlinganiselo wemilinganiselo ye-x ne-y wahluka phakathi kweenkcazelo ezimbini, isisombululo sisibini esinye. Ukuba umlinganiselo wemilinganiselo ufanayo kodwa umlinganiselo wamaxabiso angatshintshiyo wahluka, akukho sisombululo. Ukuba umlinganiselo wamaxabiso angatshintshiyo ufanayo nawo, yinkcazelo efanayo, ngoko zikho izisombululo ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo. Umzekelo, x+2y=6 kunye ne-2x+4y=10 azinasisombululo.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.model.1: Unokuzicinga njengemigca emibini. Ukuba amathambeka ayahluka, idibana kwinqaku elinye, ngoko isisombululo sisibini esinye. Ukuba amathambeka ayafana kwaye apho idlula khona kwahlukile, iyafana kwaye ayisoze idibane, ngoko akukho sisombululo. Ukuba igqubana ngokupheleleyo, zikho izisombululo ezininzi ngokungenasiphelo. Ngoko ngenxa nje yokuba kukho iinkcazelo ezimbini, ayihlali isibini esinye.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Impendulo evela kwinkcazelo yegrafu. Endaweni yokuyivakalisa ngemilinganiselo namaxabiso angatshintshiyo, yathi into efanayo isebenzisa ithambeka kunye ne-'ndawo idlula kuyo umgca'.
